description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.6.4-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed artist pictures not showing during library scans
- Fixed Artists grid pictures waiting for all downloads to finish
- Fixed albums missing genre when the first song has none
- Fixed music server songs with several genres only listed under one
- Fixed scanning text staying stuck after startup scan
- Fixed grey Deezer placeholder pictures
- Fixed slider red and grey edge artifacts
- Fixed seeking back before the first lyric leaving an old line lit
- Fixed TTML lyrics losing syllable timing in several conversions
- Fixed TTML duet singers being dropped on save
- Fixed TTML text before a line's first timed word disappearing
- Fixed adlib translations showing as sung lines after TTML import
- Fixed TTML pasted into Edit Info being saved as raw XML
- Fixed background vocals being dropped on save in four editors
- Fixed Lyrics Studio dropping the second singer on duet saves
- Fixed re-timing a line not moving its word timings
- Fixed translation and romaji lines turning into separate sung lines
- Fixed repeated timestamps saving incorrect word times
- Fixed clearing a line's time leaving raw tags
- Fixed tag edits failing on the playing song on Windows
- Fixed failed saves on read-only files leaving a full copy behind
- Fixed misleading error message when a save is blocked
- Fixed hi-res ALAC files with index at end reading wrong sample rate
- Fixed animated artwork search with artist names finding nothing
- Fixed Apple Music links with long numbers opening the wrong album
- Fixed slow previews overwriting the current animated artwork search
- Fixed taskbar tooltips not following the app language
- Fixed Discord status not updating for a paused song
- Fixed Discord cutting an emoji in long titles
- Fixed Lyrics Studio losing edits when quitting
- Fixed Lyrics Studio tap mode continuing after Re-sync
- Fixed Lyrics Studio step buttons read incorrectly by screen readers
- Fixed live preview leaving unsaved timings on the lyrics page
- Fixed held ELRC words looking choppy
- Fixed slow emphasis landing on the wrong words
- Fixed saved TTML losing spaces between words in other apps
- Fixed Chinese and Japanese lyrics getting spaces between characters
- Fixed Apple Music cover links returning 300 pixels
- Fixed Lyrics Studio AVX error on some processors
- Fixed Open Folder failing on Fedora after updates
- Fixed Show in Folder reporting success without opening anything on Linux
- Fixed Queue panel being see-through with Liquid Glass off
- Fixed Edit Info lyrics scrollbar overlapping rounded corners
- Fixed Artists sort button showing over Cover Flow
- Fixed island artwork toggling the Mini Player on release
- Fixed engine input leaving a file open after close
- Fixed Settings sliders stuttering on fast drags
- Fixed blurred background behind Settings jumping
- Fixed first letter sliced on held words like "why" and "way"
- Fixed next lyric line flashing white before it is sung
- Fixed one-letter Discord titles and artists not showing
- Fixed AC/DC and Now, Now being split apart
- Fixed names with commas being cut in metadata search and playlist import
- Fixed animated artwork pop-up wrong album label and failed counts
Added
- Added album genre display as separate entries
- Added duet overlap for two singers
- Added .m4b audiobook support
- Added Chapters menu for audiobooks
- Added keyboard star rating in Edit Info
- Added taskbar media controls switch
- Added Discord status choice for artist, song or Noctis
- Added Lyrics Studio nudge bar
- Added Lyrics Studio live preview
- Added Inbox for new songs found by rescans and folder watching
- Added lrc.red and Unison lyrics sources
- Added Headphone Surround for multi-channel files on Windows
- Added drag playing song onto playlists or queue
- Added artist name hover outlines on the player island
- Added Queue Reshuffle button
- Added Shuffle and Repeat to mini player Pill and Sleeve designs
- Added mini player queue reordering and removal
- Added Artists list view with sortable columns
- Added new user Home empty and scanning states
- Added animated artwork search grid with preview
- Added Apple Music style lyrics glow and lift
- Added Glow and Lift switch in lyrics settings
- Added keep these names together setting
- Added new-install defaults for tint, fade and artist sorting
Improved
- Improved screen reader names across the app
- Improved Artists search empty-state message
- Improved lyric scroll timing and easing
- Improved audio file handling for ALAC and m4a
- Improved Linux Show in Folder reliability
Full Changelog: v1.6.3...v1.6.4
